adrContent:
# ADR-001: Use Spring Boot for Microservices

## Context
We need a framework that supports rapid microservice development with strong ecosystem support.

## Decision
Adopt Spring Boot 2.7 with Java 17.

## Consequences
- Mature dependency injection
- Excellent observability integrations
- Large talent pool
cicdSnippet:
name: CI
on: [push]
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: "17"
      - name: Build with Maven
        run: mvn -B package --file pom.xml
